name: media-manager
description: Cognito-authenticated presigned-URL minter for browser → S3 media uploads

scripts.build: esbuild index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
